notes.title: 价格调整和英文版更新
notes.notes:
由于安装文件夹存在中文，导致英文版操作系统无法正常进入游戏。目前已将安装文件夹更新为英文，可以顺利进入游戏。

为了配合即将到来的促销活动，也为了感谢广大玩家对《迷你道教》的厚爱，我们下调了游戏价格。
Due to the presence of Chinese in the installation folder, the English operating system can't enter the game normally. Currently, the installation folder has been updated to English and you can enter the game smoothly.

In order to cooperate with the upcoming promotional activities and thanks many players for their love to Mini Taoism, we have lowered the price of the game.
